description: Table for storing expense records including details like amount, category, vendor, and status.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the expense record.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency code for the expense amount.

columns.name: category_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the expense category.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: Optional foreign key to the vendor.

columns.name: payment_account_id
columns.description: Optional foreign key to the payment account.

columns.name: reimbursable
columns.description: Indicates if the expense is reimbursable.

columns.name: receipt_url
columns.description: Optional URL to the receipt image or document.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Foreign key to the user who created the expense.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the expense was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the expense was last updated.
